Construct a transit ephemeris decision as four short exact arithmetic expressions. The expression variables are a=anchor day, t=reference midpoint day, p=orbital period days, u=reference midpoint marginal standard deviation days, v=period marginal standard deviation days, d=nominal duration hours, and n=the integer from the epoch expression. Use Python expression syntax, integers, + - * /, abs, ceil, floor, and parentheses. Return one JSON object with string fields epoch, low, high, limit. No explanation or code fence. epoch gives the first linear-model center at or after a, including negative epochs. low and high bound the propagated time standard deviation in seconds across all admissible correlations. limit is the unrounded target in seconds, one twelfth of nominal duration. Leave rounding, source witness, missing fields, time basis checks and classification to the evaluator.
